reasons.plausibility: The hypothesis is too vague; it merely states that optimizing SRO and microstructure improves properties without specifying what SRO configuration or microstructural features are targeted, making it scientifically hollow.
reasons.testability: The proposed test is generic (vary heat treatment, measure properties) and lacks a decisive criterion because 'optimized' is undefined, so a null result could always be blamed on insufficient optimization.
reasons.usefulness: The hypothesis offers no actionable direction beyond 'optimize SRO and microstructure,' which is already the general goal of the field, so it provides little new guidance to a researcher.
